Commands:
CREATE TABLE "ExecutionLog" (
    "Id" INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_ExecutionLog" PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    "PlanOperationId" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "TimestampUtc" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Level" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Message" TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE "Plan" (
    "Id" TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_Plan" PRIMARY KEY,
    "CreatedUtc" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "SourceDatabasePath" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "SourceRootId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "SourceRootPath" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "TargetRootId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "TargetRootPath" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Planned',
    "EstimatedBytesCopied" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);
CREATE TABLE "StorageRoot" (
    "Id" TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_StorageRoot" PRIMARY KEY,
    "Name" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Path" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Writable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    "FileSystemId" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
    "CaseSensitivity" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
    "CreatedUtc" TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE "PlanOperation" (
    "Id" INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_PlanOperation" PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    "PlanId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "Type" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "SourceKind" TEXT NULL,
    "SourceRootId" TEXT NULL,
    "SourcePath" TEXT NULL,
    "DestinationRootId" TEXT NULL,
    "DestinationPath" TEXT NULL,
    "ExpectedSize" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    "ExpectedHash" TEXT NULL,
    "Status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Planned',
    "StartedUtc" TEXT NULL,
    "CompletedUtc" TEXT NULL,
    "Error" TEXT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "FK_PlanOperation_Plan_PlanId" FOREIGN KEY ("PlanId") REFERENCES "Plan" ("Id") ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE "FileEntry" (
    "Id" INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_FileEntry" PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    "StorageRootId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "RelativePath" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Name" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Size" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "ModifiedUtc" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "CreatedUtc" TEXT NULL,
    "FileIdentity" TEXT NULL,
    "LastSeenScanId" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "Status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Ok',
    "Error" TEXT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "AK_FileEntry_StorageRootId_RelativePath" UNIQUE ("StorageRootId", "RelativePath"),
    CONSTRAINT "FK_FileEntry_StorageRoot_StorageRootId" FOREIGN KEY ("StorageRootId") REFERENCES "StorageRoot" ("Id")
);
CREATE TABLE "Scan" (
    "Id" INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_Scan" PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    "StorageRootId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "StartedUtc" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "CompletedUtc" TEXT NULL,
    "Status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Started',
    CONSTRAINT "FK_Scan_StorageRoot_StorageRootId" FOREIGN KEY ("StorageRootId") REFERENCES "StorageRoot" ("Id")
);
CREATE TABLE "FileHash" (
    "FileEntryId" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "Algorithm" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Digest" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "SizeAtHash" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "ModifiedUtcAtHash" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "CalculatedUtc" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "State" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Ok',
    CONSTRAINT "PK_FileHash" PRIMARY KEY ("FileEntryId", "Algorithm"),
    CONSTRAINT "FK_FileHash_FileEntry_FileEntryId" FOREIGN KEY ("FileEntryId") REFERENCES "FileEntry" ("Id") ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX "IX_FileEntry_Root" ON "FileEntry" ("StorageRootId");
CREATE INDEX "IX_FileEntry_Size" ON "FileEntry" ("Size");
CREATE INDEX "IX_FileHash_Digest" ON "FileHash" ("Algorithm", "Digest");
CREATE INDEX "IX_PlanOp_Plan" ON "PlanOperation" ("PlanId", "Sequence");
CREATE INDEX "IX_Scan_StorageRootId" ON "Scan" ("StorageRootId");

ALTER TABLE "Plan" ADD "ExecutionSourceRootPath" TEXT NULL;
ALTER TABLE "Plan" ADD "ExecutionTargetRootPath" TEXT NULL;

CREATE TABLE "ScanCheckpoint" (
    "StorageRootId" TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_ScanCheckpoint" PRIMARY KEY,
    "RootPath" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "VolumeIdentity" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "RootIdentity" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "JournalId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "NextUsn" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "ScanId" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "FK_ScanCheckpoint_StorageRoot_StorageRootId" FOREIGN KEY ("StorageRootId") REFERENCES "StorageRoot" ("Id") ON DELETE CASCADE
);
